text: dsh-new-session 是面向 DSH Web 的会话命令插件，在浏览器端注册 /new 动作。用户在输入区调用后，插件通过当前工作区界面创建并打开会话；它不提交尚未发送的输入草稿，也不要求额外配置。适合希望在当前工作区快速开始另一段会话的 DSH Web 用户。代码实现仅包含客户端命令和启用该客户端入口的宿主插件。

dsh-new-session adds a browser-side /new command to DSH Web. Run it in the input area to start and open a session in the current workspace; the unsent draft stays untouched. It is useful when you want to begin another session without losing your draft.
想在当前工作区快速开一个新会话，并保留输入框里还没发送的草稿。
How can I start and open another session in my current DSH Web workspace without sending my draft?
dsh-new-session 的功能「在当前工作区新开会话」：在输入区运行 /new 后，浏览器端调用工作区界面启动并打开一个新会话；该动作不会提交当前未发送的草稿。
dsh-new-session 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 44 天；提交数 7；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-new-session README · dsh-new-session：Adds `/new` to the DSH Web input. It opens a session in the current workspace (or the most recently used workspace), like the workspace **+** button. An existing empty session may be reused. Your unsent composer draft is not submitted.

dsh-new-session README · Install：Install the tagged GitHub release into your DSH Web profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add 'https://github.com/yoggu/dsh-new-session.git#v0.1.2'
```

Or download the source and link the local checkout:

```sh
git clone --branch v0.1.2 --depth 1 https://github.com/yoggu/dsh-new-session.git
cd dsh-new-session
dsh plugin --profile web add "link:$(pwd)"
```

Keep a linked checkout in place while the plugin is installed. Use the profile you actually run if it is not `web`.

dsh-new-session README · Install：Restart DSH Web if the plugin does not appear immediately, then reload the page. Use `/new` in the input field. No configuration or credentials are required.

To uninstall: `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-new-session`.
